title: Web Development Intern
description:
**Skills required**

* Backend language (any one):
* Node.js (Express / NestJS) ✅ most common OR Python (Django / FastAPI)
* REST API design
* Database PostgreSQL / MySQL (main data)
* Redis (caching AQI values)
* Handling large time-series data
* Authentication (Admin panel, APIs)HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
* React.js or Next.js (aqi.in uses heavy dynamic UI)
* Chart libraries:
* Chart.js / Recharts / D3.js / ApexCharts
* Map integration:
* Google Maps API / Mapbox / Leaflet
* Responsive design (mobile + desktop)
* API consumption (REST APIs)
* Basic SEO-friendly frontend (SSR preferred → Next.js)

**Frontend**

* Next.js (React)
* Tailwind CSS
* Recharts / D3.js
* Mapbox

**Backend**

* Node.js + NestJS
* PostgreSQL
* Redis

**Cloud**

* AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudFront)

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹9,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
